videos.overview: Rattled by her own lies and under pressure from the FBI, Cassie goes against her lawyer best friend Annie’s advice to lay low and tries to find some answers by digging into Alex’s work life - with bizarre and shocking results.

videos.name: Funeralia
videos.overview: Returning from Rome to find that someone has broken into her apartment, Cassie doubles down on finding Miranda - even if it means crashing a champagne-soaked memorial service at Alex's family home.
